import example.bankwealth.v2.infrastructure.connectors.DefaultOutboundConnectors
import example.bankwealth.v2.infrastructure.persistence.InMemoryStore
import example.bankwealth.v2.interfaces.api.{AllowAllAuthority, HttpAuthority}
import example.bankwealth.v2.interfaces.http.HttpRouter

final case class OnionRuntime(router: HttpRouter, store: InMemoryStore, connectors: OutboundConnectorsPort)

object OnionBootstrap {
  def createRuntime(
    cashFundPurchaseHandler: Option[example.bankwealth.v2.application.services.CashFundPurchaseHandler] = None,
    cashFundPurchaseExterns: Option[example.bankwealth.v2.application.services.CashFundPurchaseExternPorts] = None,
    taBridgeSettlementHandler: Option[example.bankwealth.v2.application.services.TaBridgeSettlementHandler] = None,
    taBridgeSettlementExterns: Option[example.bankwealth.v2.application.services.TaBridgeSettlementExternPorts] = None,
    authority: HttpAuthority = AllowAllAuthority,
    store: InMemoryStore = new InMemoryStore()
  ): OnionRuntime = {
    val connectors = new DefaultOutboundConnectors(store)
    val router = new HttpRouter(
      cashFundPurchaseController = cashFundPurchaseHandler.map(h => new example.bankwealth.v2.interfaces.http.CashFundPurchaseController(h, cashFundPurchaseExterns.getOrElse(connectors.cashFundPurchaseExterns), connectors.cashFundPurchaseEffects)),
      taBridgeSettlementController = taBridgeSettlementHandler.map(h => new example.bankwealth.v2.interfaces.http.TaBridgeSettlementController(h, taBridgeSettlementExterns.getOrElse(connectors.taBridgeSettlementExterns), connectors.taBridgeSettlementEffects)),
      authority = authority
    )
    OnionRuntime(router = router, store = store, connectors = connectors)
  }
}
